EPH.1.3-4.text: Paul praises God who blessed and chose believers in Christ

EPH.1.5-6.text: God chose believers to be his children through Jesus

EPH.1.7-8.text: In Christ believers are forgiven through his blood

EPH.1.9-10.text: God made known his plan to unite all things in Christ

EPH.1.11-12.text: God chose believers as his own people for his praise

EPH.1.13-14.text: Believers who heard and believed receive the Holy Spirit

EPH.1.15-16.text: Paul thanks God for the Ephesians’ faith and love

EPH.1.17-18.text: Paul prays for believers to have wisdom to know God

EPH.1.19-21.text: God’s great power raised Christ and set him over all

EPH.1.22-23.text: God made Christ head over everything for the church

EPH.2.1-3.text: Before Christ, believers were dead in sin

EPH.2.4-7.text: God in his mercy made believers alive with Christ

EPH.2.8-10.text: God saves believers by grace through faith, not by works

EPH.2.11-12.text: Gentile believers were once far from Christ and Israel

EPH.2.13-16.text: Christ makes Jews and Gentiles one through the cross

EPH.2.17-18.text: Christ brings peace so all can come to the Father

EPH.3.1-2.text: Paul is a prisoner who serves the Gentiles by God’s grace

EPH.3.3-5.text: God showed Paul the mystery of Christ by revelation

EPH.3.6-7.text: Gentiles are fellow heirs in Christ through the gospel

EPH.3.8-9.text: Paul was given grace to preach Christ to the Gentiles

EPH.3.10-11.text: God shows his wisdom to rulers through the church

EPH.3.12-13.text: In Christ believers can come to God with confidence

EPH.3.14-16.text: Paul prays that God will strengthen believers with power

EPH.3.17-19.text: Paul prays that believers will know Christ’s great love

EPH.3.20-21.text: Paul gives glory to God who can do more than we ask

EPH.4.1-3.text: Paul urges believers to live humbly and keep unity

EPH.4.4-6.text: Believers share one body, one Lord, and one God

EPH.4.7-8.text: Christ gives grace to each believer as a gift

EPH.4.9-10.text: Christ went down and then rose above all the heavens

EPH.4.11-13.text: Christ gave leaders to prepare believers for service

EPH.4.14-16.text: Believers grow up in Christ and build up the body in love

EPH.4.17-19.text: Paul tells believers not to live like the Gentiles

EPH.4.20-22.text: Believers were taught to put off the old self

EPH.4.23-24.text: Believers are to be renewed and put on the new self

EPH.4.25-27.text: Believers must speak truth and not stay angry

EPH.4.28-30.text: Believers must work, share, and speak helpful words

EPH.4.31-32.text: Believers must get rid of anger and forgive each other

EPH.5.1-2.text: Believers should imitate God and walk in love like Christ

EPH.5.3-4.text: Believers must avoid sexual sin, greed, and foolish talk

EPH.5.5-7.text: Immoral and greedy people have no share in God’s kingdom

EPH.5.8-12.text: Believers are now light and must avoid deeds of darkness

EPH.5.13-14.text: Light shows what is hidden; Christ calls sleepers to wake

EPH.5.15-17.text: Believers should live wisely and know the Lord’s will

EPH.5.18-20.text: Believers are to be filled with the Spirit and give thanks

EPH.5.21-21.text: Believers submit to one another out of respect for Christ

EPH.5.22-24.text: Wives should submit to husbands as to the Lord

EPH.5.25-27.text: Husbands must love wives as Christ loved the church

EPH.5.28-30.text: A husband who loves his wife loves himself

EPH.5.31-33.text: Husbands must love wives, and wives must respect husbands

EPH.6.1-3.text: Children must obey and honor father and mother

EPH.6.4-4.text: Fathers must raise children with the Lord’s teaching

EPH.6.5-8.text: Slaves must obey masters sincerely, as serving Christ

EPH.6.9-9.text: Masters must treat slaves well and stop threatening

EPH.6.10-11.text: Paul urges believers to be strong and wear God’s armor

EPH.6.12-13.text: Believers fight evil spiritual forces, not people

EPH.6.14-16.text: Believers stand firm with truth, righteousness, and faith

EPH.6.17-18.text: Believers take salvation and God’s word, and pray always

EPH.6.19-20.text: Paul asks believers to pray that he will speak boldly

EPH.6.21-22.text: Paul sends Tychicus to inform and encourage the church

EPH.6.23-24.text: Paul ends with peace, love, and grace for believers
